5-day-fly-in-serengeti-wildebeest-migrat.title: Flight to the northern Serengeti
body: After a hotel pickup in Arusha you fly for about an hour to the Kogatende airstrip in the far north. Your private 4x4 and guide are waiting, and you head straight out on a first game drive toward the Mara River country.

5-day-fly-in-serengeti-wildebeest-migrat.title: A day at the Mara River
body: You set out early to find the herds in the remote north, with your guide watching for the restless build-up that comes before a crossing. From July to October the river banks can be thick with wildebeest and zebra, and crocodiles wait below. Picnic lunch keeps you in the field. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Tented Camp.

5-day-fly-in-serengeti-wildebeest-migrat.title: From the Serengeti to the crater
body: You leave the Serengeti after a final game drive and climb into the highlands, then descend into Ngorongoro Crater for a game drive on its floor, with lunch by the water. Keep an eye out for lion, buffalo, hippo and elephant before you continue to your lodge. Tonight you sleep at Farm of dreams.

5-day-fly-in-serengeti-wildebeest-migrat.title: Tarangire, then Arusha
body: You drive from the crater highlands toward Arusha, with a last game drive in Tarangire on the way among elephants and baobabs. The safari ends in Arusha in the evening.

7-day-mara-river-crossing-safari-the-gre.title: Landing in Arusha
body: A member of our team meets you at the airport and takes you to your hotel in Arusha. Your guide stops by for a short briefing on the route ahead, and you can rest after the flight. Tonight you sleep at Gold Crest Hotel.

7-day-mara-river-crossing-safari-the-gre.title: A day in Tarangire
body: Tarangire opens your safari with huge baobabs and some of the largest elephant herds in the north. You drive the river loop and the woodland tracks, looking for lion, giraffe, buffalo and plenty of birds. Tonight you sleep at Farm of Dreams Lodge.

7-day-mara-river-crossing-safari-the-gre.title: Into the Serengeti
body: You climb through the Ngorongoro highlands, pause at a viewpoint over the crater if the weather allows, and descend onto the vast Serengeti plains. A game drive on the way in brings your first sightings, and the afternoon is spent around the Seronera area. Tonight you sleep at Nakupenda Luxury Camp Central Serengeti.

7-day-mara-river-crossing-safari-the-gre.title: A day at the Mara River
body: You set out early to find the herds in the remote north, with your guide watching for the restless build-up that comes before a crossing. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Migration Camp In Northern Serengeti.

7-day-mara-river-crossing-safari-the-gre.title: Heading home
body: After breakfast your driver takes you back to Arusha and on to the airport or your hotel, depending on your flight. Our team stays in touch until you are safely on your way.

3-day-great-migration-river-crossing-saf.title: North toward the Mara River
body: A long game drive carries you north through the Serengeti to the Mara River region, home to the dramatic crossings between roughly July and October. You see plenty of wildlife on the way and reach camp in the evening. Tonight you sleep at Safari Haven Migration Camp.

3-day-great-migration-river-crossing-saf.title: Last game drive and flight to Zanzibar
body: An early drive gives you one more chance to see wildlife in the soft morning light. Afterwards you head to the airstrip for your flight to Zanzibar, where the safari ends.

8-day-great-migration-calving-season-saf.title: Landing in Arusha
body: We greet you on arrival and transfer you to your hotel in Arusha, where you can unwind. In the evening your safari guide explains the plan for the coming days and answers any questions. Tonight you sleep at Kibo Palace Hotel.

8-day-great-migration-calving-season-saf.title: Elephants and baobabs in Tarangire
body: After breakfast your guide drives to Tarangire, about two hours from Arusha. The park is famed for big elephant herds, giant baobabs and, in the dry months, animals crowding along the river. You spend the day on game drives with a picnic lunch. Tonight you sleep at Farm of Dreams.

8-day-great-migration-calving-season-saf.title: Across the highlands to the Serengeti
body: You climb through the Ngorongoro highlands, pause at a viewpoint over the crater if the weather allows, and descend onto the vast Serengeti plains. A game drive on the way in brings your first sightings, and the afternoon is spent around the Seronera area. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Tented Camp.

8-day-great-migration-calving-season-saf.title: A full day in the Serengeti
body: This day is for the Serengeti alone. You set off at sunrise when predators are active and spend the hours moving between kopjes, rivers and open plains, with a picnic lunch in the bush. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Tented Camp.

8-day-great-migration-calving-season-saf.title: On to Ndutu
body: You leave the central plains and drive south toward Ndutu, the heart of the calving grounds between roughly December and March. Game viewing continues on the way, and you arrive in time for an afternoon drive among the herds. Tonight you sleep at Safari Haven Migration Camp.

8-day-great-migration-calving-season-saf.title: A full day on the calving plains
body: Today is given over to the short-grass plains around Ndutu, where wildebeest and zebra drop their young during the calving months. Your guide follows the herds, and the newborns draw lion, cheetah and hyena, so there is often action on the open ground. Tonight you sleep at Safari Haven Migration Camp.

8-day-great-migration-calving-season-saf.title: The crater floor
body: You descend early, while the animals are active, into the caldera of an ancient volcano. Its floor holds grassland, a soda lake and acacia woods, and lions, elephants, buffalo, hippos and rhino can all show up within a few hours. A picnic lunch is taken by the water. Tonight you sleep at Farm of Dreams Lodge.

body: A driver collects you from your Zanzibar hotel and takes you to the airport for a light-aircraft flight to the Serengeti. You arrive at the airstrip in time for lunch, then head out on an afternoon game drive. Tonight you sleep at Ang’ata Migration Camp.

3-day-zanzibar-to-serengeti-fly-in-and-f.title: Calving plains all day
body: You spend the whole day on the Ndutu plains, where thousands of wildebeest calves are born in the calving months. Cats and hyenas shadow the herds, so there is much to watch from the vehicle. Tonight you sleep at Ang’ata Migration Camp.

3-day-zanzibar-to-serengeti-fly-in-and-f.title: Last game drive and flight to Zanzibar
body: An early drive gives you one more chance to see wildlife in the soft morning light. Afterwards you head to the airstrip for your flight to Zanzibar, where the safari ends.

6-day-tanzania-wildebeest-calving-safari.title: Crater, then south to Ndutu
body: You drop into Ngorongoro Crater early for a game drive on its floor, then climb out and continue to the southern Serengeti and the Ndutu camp area for the evening. Tonight you sleep at Ang’ata Migration Camp.

body: A last morning game drive on the plains, then the road climbs toward the conservation area. You arrive at the highlands by the afternoon and have time to rest before tomorrow's descent into the crater. Tonight you sleep at Farm of Dreams lodge.

6-day-tanzania-wildebeest-calving-safari.title: Hunter-gatherers of Lake Eyasi
body: With a local guide and the communities' permission, you visit the Hadzabe, who hunt and forage as their ancestors did, and the Datoga, known for their metalwork. Time spent with them is an unhurried way to learn how people live around the lake. You then return to Arusha.

8-day-lake-natron-and-mara-river-migrati.title: Across the Rift Valley to Lake Natron
body: You drive north through Maasai country and along the Rift Valley escarpment to Lake Natron, a salt lake at the foot of the volcano Ol Doinyo Lengai. The heat and stark scenery feel far from the usual safari parks, and flamingos gather on the shallows. Tonight you sleep at Africa Safari Lake Natron.

8-day-lake-natron-and-mara-river-migrati.title: Waterfalls at Natron, then north to the Serengeti
body: The morning starts with a guided walk to the Ngare Sero waterfalls, a cool contrast to the dry lakeshore. After lunch you drive through the northern highlands toward the Serengeti and its migration country. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Migration Tented Camp.

8-day-lake-natron-and-mara-river-migrati.title: A full day with the herds
body: Today is all about the Great Migration in the north. Your guide moves with the herds across grassland and river valleys, looking for large movements of wildebeest and zebra and the predators that follow them. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Migration Tented Camp.

8-day-lake-natron-and-mara-river-migrati.title: South again to Seronera
body: After a morning game drive in the north you head south through changing country toward the Seronera Valley, watching for cats and elephants along the route. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Tented Camp.

1-day-fly-in-and-fly-out-mikumi-national.title: Mikumi in a day, by air
body: A morning flight takes you from Zanzibar to Mikumi, where your guide waits with a 4x4. You spend the day crossing the Mkata floodplain on game drives, looking for giraffe, zebra, buffalo, elephant and lion, with a lunch stop in the park. Late in the afternoon you fly back to the island.

1-day-ngorongoro-crater-safari-from-arus.title: Crater day from Arusha
body: You are collected from your hotel at first light and drive up through the highlands to the crater rim. A steep track leads to the floor, where you spend the morning looking for lion, buffalo, elephant, hippo and, with luck, black rhino. Lunch is a picnic, and you reach Arusha again in the evening.

1-day-tarangire-national-park-short-safa.title: One day in Tarangire
body: Your private guide collects you early and drives about two to three hours to Tarangire. You follow the river for elephants, then scan the baobab woodland for lion, giraffe and buffalo, stopping for a picnic lunch. You are back in Arusha by evening.

1-day-tarangire-national-park-joining-sa.title: Tarangire in a shared vehicle
body: You join a small group for the drive from Arusha to Tarangire. The day is spent on game drives among elephant herds and baobab trees, with a picnic lunch in the park. Your guide drives you back to Arusha in the late afternoon.

2-day-fly-in-fly-out-zanzibar-to-mikumi-.title: Fly from Zanzibar to Mikumi
body: A morning transfer takes you to Zanzibar airport and on a light-aircraft flight to Mikumi. You meet your guide on landing, enjoy lunch and set out on an afternoon game drive across the floodplain. Tonight you sleep at Double G Safari Camp.

2-day-fly-in-fly-out-zanzibar-to-mikumi-.title: Last game drive and flight to Zanzibar
body: An early drive gives you one more chance to see wildlife in the soft morning light. Afterwards you head to the airstrip for your flight to Zanzibar, where the safari ends.

body: A morning flight brings you from Zanzibar to Arusha, where you meet the team for a briefing. You then drive to Tarangire for an afternoon among elephants and baobabs before sleeping at a lodge.

9-day-tanzania-safari-lake-eyasi-and-kil.title: Serengeti game drive, then Ngorongoro
body: You spend the morning on the Serengeti plains, then drive toward the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. By evening you are on the highlands, ready for the crater tomorrow. Tonight you sleep at Simba Campsite.

9-day-tanzania-safari-lake-eyasi-and-kil.title: The crater floor
body: You descend early, while the animals are active, into the caldera of an ancient volcano. In the afternoon you continue to the Lake Eyasi area, where you sleep tonight. Tonight you sleep at Fig Tree Lodge.

9-day-tanzania-safari-lake-eyasi-and-kil.title: Hunter-gatherers of Lake Eyasi
body: With a local guide and the communities' permission, you visit the Hadzabe, who hunt and forage as their ancestors did, and the Datoga, known for their metalwork. Time spent with them is an unhurried way to learn how people live around the lake. Tonight you sleep at Karibu Heritage House.

9-day-tanzania-safari-lake-eyasi-and-kil.title: Waterfall, coffee and hot springs
body: You head to the foothills of Kilimanjaro for a walk to the Materuni waterfall, followed by a village coffee tasting where beans are roasted and ground by hand. In the afternoon you can swim in the clear water of the Kikuletwa hot springs. Tonight you sleep at Karibu Heritage House.

9-day-tanzania-safari-lake-eyasi-and-kil.title: Departure day
body: After breakfast your driver takes you back to Arusha and on to the airport or your hotel, depending on your flight. Our team stays in touch until you are safely on your way.

10-day-great-wildebeest-migration-cultur.title: Welcome to Arusha
body: We greet you on arrival and transfer you to your hotel in Arusha, where you can unwind. Arriving early gives time for a short tour of the town, its craft stalls and cafes. In the evening your safari guide explains the plan for the coming days and answers any questions. Tonight you sleep at Njiro Legacy hotel.

10-day-great-wildebeest-migration-cultur.title: Across the Rift Valley to Lake Natron
body: You drive north through Maasai country and along the Rift Valley escarpment to Lake Natron, a salt lake at the foot of the volcano Ol Doinyo Lengai. The heat and stark scenery feel far from the usual safari parks, and flamingos gather on the shallows. Tonight you sleep at Lake Natron Tented Camp.

10-day-great-wildebeest-migration-cultur.title: Waterfalls at Natron, then north to the Serengeti
body: The morning starts with a guided walk to the Ngare Sero waterfalls, a cool contrast to the dry lakeshore. After lunch you drive through the northern highlands toward the Serengeti and its migration country. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Tented Camp.

10-day-great-wildebeest-migration-cultur.title: A day at the Mara River
body: You set out early to find the herds in the remote north, with your guide watching for the restless build-up that comes before a crossing. From July to October the river banks can be thick with wildebeest and zebra, and crocodiles wait below. Picnic lunch keeps you in the field. Tonight you sleep at Moyo tented camp.

10-day-great-wildebeest-migration-cultur.title: South again to Seronera
body: After a morning game drive in the north you head south through changing country toward the Seronera Valley, watching for cats and elephants along the route. Tonight you sleep at Moyo Tented camp.

body: A final drive at sunrise, when the plains are golden and the cats are still active, then a transfer to the airstrip for your flight back to Zanzibar.

3-day-tanzania-small-group-safari-sereng.title: Crater, then back to Arusha
body: You leave the Serengeti early, climb to the highlands and descend into Ngorongoro Crater for a game drive. After lunch you drive back to Arusha.

ngorongoro-day-trip-joining-safari-tanza.title: Crater day from Arusha
body: You are collected from your hotel at first light and drive up through the highlands to the crater rim. A steep track leads to the floor, where you spend the morning looking for lion, buffalo, elephant, hippo and, with luck, black rhino. Lunch is a picnic, and you reach Arusha again in the evening.

3-day-lake-natron-adventure-and-oldoinyo.title: Rift Valley drive to Lake Natron
body: You leave Arusha early and drive through Maasai villages and the dramatic Rift Valley to Lake Natron. After settling in you can walk to the shore of the lake or cool off in a nearby stream.

3-day-lake-natron-adventure-and-oldoinyo.title: Night climb of Ol Doinyo Lengai
body: You start soon after midnight to climb the volcano in cooler air. The trail is steep and loose and needs good fitness. You reach the crater rim as the sun rises and look out over the lake before descending to camp.

3-day-lake-natron-adventure-and-oldoinyo.title: Maasai village and return
body: After breakfast you visit a Maasai village to see homes, songs and daily routines, then drive back to Arusha.

4-day-usambara-mountains-hiking-and-cult.title: Lushoto and the Irente viewpoint
body: You arrive in the market town of Lushoto, settle in and walk in the afternoon to the Irente viewpoint, where the mountains drop away to the plains.

4-day-usambara-mountains-hiking-and-cult.title: Magamba forest and village life
body: A guided hike through the cool Magamba forest brings birds, monkeys and tall old trees, and you finish with a visit to a local household to learn about farming in the highlands.

4-day-usambara-mountains-hiking-and-cult.title: Sunrise walk to Mtae
body: An early start takes you along the escarpment to Mtae village, arriving as the first light spreads over the plains below. The rest of the day is easy.

4-day-usambara-mountains-hiking-and-cult.title: Lushoto market and departure
body: A last stroll through the Lushoto market for crafts and produce, then the journey onward.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.title: Arrival and briefing
body: You land at Kilimanjaro International Airport and our driver takes you to your hotel. In the evening your lead guide runs a short briefing on the route, checks your gear and answers questions before the climb starts tomorrow.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.title: Trailhead to Mandara Hut
body: After breakfast you drive to Marangu Gate, register with the rangers and meet your porters. The trek begins in forest on a well-made trail, and the pace is deliberately slow. Mandara Hut sits in the forest, where colobus monkeys often swing through the trees.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.title: Mandara Hut to Horombo Hut
body: You follow the trail the porters use across open ground, resting often and drinking plenty. The mountain changes character around every bend. Horombo Hut stands in open moorland among giant groundsels, with the jagged Mawenzi peak across the valley.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.title: Horombo Hut to Kibo Hut
body: The trail climbs on through changing scenery, and your guide keeps a slow, steady pace, with regular stops for water and snacks. Kibo Hut lies on the lunar-looking saddle between Kibo and Mawenzi, a bare, windy spot where you rest early before the midnight start.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.title: Summit day: Uhuru Peak
body: You set off in the dark with headlamps and walk slowly up steep, loose ground in the cold. At sunrise you reach Stella Point on the crater rim and continue to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa at 5,895 metres. After photographs you head back down, taking a rest at camp before continuing to Horombo Hut.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climbing-adventu.title: Down to Marangu Gate
body: The last stretch drops through the rainforest on a steep path that can be hard on the knees. At the gate you sign out, collect your summit certificate if you reached the top, and our driver takes you back to your hotel for a hot shower.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climb-via-umbwe-.title: Arrival and briefing
body: You land at Kilimanjaro International Airport and our driver takes you to your hotel. In the evening your lead guide runs a short briefing on the route, checks your gear and answers questions before the climb starts tomorrow.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climb-via-umbwe-.title: Trailhead to Umbwe Cave Camp
body: After breakfast you drive to Umbwe Gate, register with the rangers and meet your porters. The trek begins in forest on a well-made trail, and the pace is deliberately slow. Umbwe Cave Camp is reached by a steep, root-covered path through dense forest, and the camp sits tucked beneath the trees.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climb-via-umbwe-.title: Umbwe Cave Camp to Barranco Camp
body: The trail climbs on through changing scenery, and your guide keeps a slow, steady pace, with regular stops for water and snacks. Barranco Camp lies in a valley dotted with giant senecio plants, right beneath the great rock face of the Barranco Wall.

5-day-mount-kilimanjaro-climb-via-umbwe-.title: Barranco Wall
body: The day begins with the Barranco Wall, a steep scramble that needs hands in a few places but no climbing skills. From the top you look over the valley you left, then walk across ridges and valleys. Barafu means ice in Swahili, and this rocky ridge camp is cold and exposed. You eat early and sleep a few hours before the summit attempt.

body: You follow the trail the porters use across open ground, resting often and drinking plenty. The mountain changes character around every bend. The camp stands on the wide Shira Plateau, with open views toward Kibo and, on clear evenings, Mount Meru.

body: A climb up toward Lava Tower takes you above 4,600 metres, which is excellent for acclimatising. Barranco Camp lies in a valley dotted with giant senecio plants, right beneath the great rock face of the Barranco Wall.
